_comment: workload family 'depth_chain' on the rvvpair machine configuration (0 gemmini + 2 rvv harts). @generated by experiments/workload_gen/mk_workloads.py. Periods are derived from each model's analytic MAC count anchored to the measured single-hart runtime of its default rung, so they are tight but satisfiable. Networks joined by `edges` form a dependency chain and share one derived period, covering the whole chain's latency.
discrimination_note: every network is periodic, so schedule_decoder.evaluate scores (num_instances-1)*period + critical path -- a property of the spec, not of any schedule. Every solver that finds a feasible schedule returns the same objective, so this cell cannot rank a scheduler.
